display_name: Obstructive/Mixed Apnea-Hypopnea Index (Supine): (Obstructive apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal +mixed apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with >= 3% oxygen desaturation or with arousal) / hour of sleep in supine position from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - Apnea hypopnea index (3% desats) in back
calculation: 60*(oarbp + oanbp + marbp +  manrbp + hremba3 + hnrba3)/(remepbp + nremepbp)
